scope: Formal private class chat HTTP handler, production Agent and review pipeline, real Vertex Gemini, two synthetic class records in isolated Firestore transaction fixture.
before: The model invented child UUIDs on a first read even though the authenticated conversation already held both children. The rejected requests produced no answer.
change: The application binds the selected children. The tool accepts filters and server-returned positions. Event dates follow each original record's time zone. Records and scan coverage provide separate review sources.
